items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: WKCR has been mistreated by Columbia University, the FCC and Osama Bin Laden and Bin Laden is in third place.

ctx.x: And I really wish I could pick up your radio station where we live. © Fillius Jazz Archive -25-

Yeah well we’re having a lot of problems, you know, we were in the World Trade Center and I’ll leave something on the record here because I feel that strongly about it, but I’ll make it a joke. I’ll close with a joke. Some jazz musicians like to do that. WKCR has been mistreated by Columbia University, the FCC and Osama Bin Laden and Bin Laden is in third place.
All right. Enough said. Well maybe next time around we’ll understand why. Well I want to thank you for all the things you’ve done in this business.
